$comment: The Straatfeestseizoen newsletter as an A/B test, as PqNieuwsbriefABTest draws it (coordinator 28 Oct, board canon): the sent newsletter is variant A, and a variant B blast (abVariantOf) went out at the same moment. Each arm sends its own template, so A reads "Straatfeest deze zomer? Dit moet je regelen" and B "Je straatfeest, geregeld in 4 stappen". Each arm has more than 500 delivered and was sent more than 24 hours ago, so the page computes a verdict: A clicks about 15%, B about 26%, B significantly higher (p < 0.05). The segment's 412 contacts and the board's 203/201 figures follow in a board amend.
